design_reasoning.rationale: The project explains bounded detection and quarantine trade-offs without claiming complete prompt-injection prevention.

observable_requirements.description: Compare blocking, annotation, and quarantine while defining false-positive and bypass limits.
Implement the selected allow, annotate, and quarantine outcomes with structured reasons.

architecture_maintainability.rationale: Normalization, signal detection, secret redaction, policy, and audit output remain separately testable.

observable_requirements.description: Compose pure detection and redaction stages without allowing evidence text to become executable instruction.

security_by_design.rationale: The threat model treats indirect instructions and secret-shaped material as inert untrusted evidence.

observable_requirements.description: Map prompt influence, data exfiltration, encoding tricks, and audit tampering to bounded controls.
Classify untrusted content into allow, annotate, or quarantine outcomes using explicit reasons.
Replace secret-shaped assignments before content reaches downstream assessment evidence.

testing_evidence.rationale: Adversarial tests cover direct and indirect instructions, encoded variants, false positives, and secret redaction.

observable_requirements.description: Exercise inert prompt text, obfuscation, contextual false positives, and unsupported language.
Exercise credential assignments, benign identifiers, repeated secrets, and bounded output.

documentation_operations.rationale: Setup and triage are documented, while production tuning and multilingual response procedures remain intentionally limited.

observable_requirements.description: Document bounded integration, signal meanings, and non-guarantees for operators.
Document review and release procedures for quarantined evidence.

repository_hygiene.rationale: The repository pins dependencies and includes licensing, automation, contribution, and security guidance.

observable_requirements.description: Commit deterministic dependency metadata for reproducible inspection.
Publish a recognized license granting reuse and modification rights.
Define automated unit and adversarial corpus checks without runtime claims.
Document private reporting for bypass or redaction vulnerabilities.
Require regression corpus additions for policy and detector changes.

implemented_safeguards.threat: Repository content attempts to control the assessment process or override evaluation instructions.
implemented_safeguards.control: The pipeline labels instruction-like evidence and returns structured reasons without executing or forwarding it as authority.

implemented_safeguards.threat: A committed fake or real credential assignment is copied into downstream evidence or output.
implemented_safeguards.control: Credential-shaped values are replaced with typed redaction markers while paths and signal kinds remain auditable.

negative_boundary_cases.behavior: Quarantine text that instructs an evaluator to award a maximum score.
Annotate rather than blindly quarantine a defensive document quoting an attack.
Redact a secret-shaped assignment while preserving its evidence location.

track_evidence.rationale: The product primarily detects, contains, and supports investigation of prompt influence and secret-exfiltration threats.

known_limitations.description: Heuristic signals cannot establish that all semantically equivalent indirect instructions are detected.
The committed adversarial corpus intentionally provides incomplete non-English coverage.

excluded_runtime_claims: Whether the project builds or starts
Performance, scaling, or reliability under load
Ability to extend the system safely
